scope: Read-only AI source review, not human audit or native/hardware proof.

resolved_findings.problem: Shell/window actions were applied before superseded-input ACK validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: ACK is checked before shell handling; superseded offers cancel queues/captures and revoke clipboard then continue.

resolved_findings.problem: Shell-consumed mouse events left the displayed pointer at old coordinates.
resolved_findings.resolution: Compositor pointer updates before shell hit handling.
